decision: held: the record's main source for its glutathione-stores/immune claim (24791752, Eur J Nutr 2015) has no open full text, so the material (Setria or not), dosage form and outcome details cannot be verified beyond the abstract; the only full-text source (28490897) measures skin, not the record's goals, and is closed without credit
summary: Abstract of 24791752: 54 adults, 250 or 1,000 mg/day oral GSH for 6 months raised blood and cell glutathione 17-35% (260% buccal at high dose), and NK cytotoxicity rose over twofold at 3 months in the high-dose group; the abstract does not name Setria or the dosage form. Full text of 28490897 confirms Setria 250 mg/day capsules in 60 Thai women, with a primary melanin-index result that was not significant; that context is approved without credit. The record stays held until 24791752 can be verified.

population.description: 60 healthy Thai women aged 20-50 recruited in Bangkok, randomized equally to Setria GSH 250 mg/d, GSSG 250 mg/d or placebo; 3 withdrew (two for raised liver tests, one for starting oral contraception).

study_contexts.study_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel three-arm trial, 12 weeks; primary outcome melanin index (Mexameter) at six sites; GEE analysis.

outcomes.name: Primary melanin index and UV spots at all sites: lower than placebo only as a non-significant trend (P>0.05); forearm melanin lower in a post hoc >40-year subgroup (GSH n=7 vs placebo n=10, P=0.031).
Wrinkles reduced at some sites and elasticity trended higher with GSH; skin water content at one site was lower with GSH than placebo (P=0.031).

limitations: Separate GSSG arm cannot be credited as independent Setria replication.
Two withdrew for elevated LFTs; causality not established; no blanketnosafetyissue.
The source-specific outcome hierarchy is recorded above. No clinical approval, product correspondence or release completion is inferred from this factual extraction.
No credit: the primary skin outcome was not significant and skin lightening is not this record's Immune Support or Healthy Aging goal; product supplied by the Setria maker.
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.

normalization.basis: Assigned material mass in mg from source; not marker conversion or universal benchmark.

source_provenance.location: Full text (PMC5413479): Methods (participants, Setria/AquaGluta capsules from Kyowa Hakko Bio, primary outcome), Results melanin/TEWL/wrinkle paragraphs and Table 2.
